scenarios.title: A｜接受
scenarios.setting: 在“对方突然取消约会”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“接受”。

turns.text: I’m really sorry, but I need to cancel tonight. Something came up with my family.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Of course. Don’t worry about tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Don’t worry about tonight.
feedback.explanation: 明确说出担心之处，方便对方针对顾虑解释；没有把担心直接说成已发生的事实。

choices.text: No problem. I hope everything’s okay.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. I hope everything’s okay.
feedback.explanation: “I hope”表达希望而非保证，适合祝愿或说明对后续的期待。

choices.text: That’s okay. Take care of what you need to.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. Take care of what you need to.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: Don’t worry about me. We can always reschedule.

feedback.naturalExpression: Don’t worry about me. We can always reschedule.
feedback.explanation: 明确说出担心之处，方便对方针对顾虑解释；没有把担心直接说成已发生的事实。

turns.text: Thanks for understanding. I feel bad canceling so late.

turns.prompt: 你想体谅对方临时的家庭安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Really, it’s fine. Family comes first.

feedback.naturalExpression: Really, it’s fine. Family comes first.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: Don’t feel bad. We’ll figure out another day.

feedback.naturalExpression: Don’t feel bad. We’ll figure out another day.
feedback.explanation: “figure out”表示想明白或弄清楚，强调经过思考找到办法。

choices.text: It’s okay. Just let me know when things settle down.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s okay. Just let me know when things settle down.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

turns.prompt: 你想表达支持和祝愿，会怎么说？

choices.text: Of course. Hope everything works out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Hope everything works out.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Take care. Talk soon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Take care. Talk soon.
feedback.explanation: 用简短告别为对话收尾，既确认交流结束，也保留友好的语气。

scenarios.title: B｜询问原因
scenarios.setting: 在“对方突然取消约会”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问原因”。

turns.text: Hey, I’m sorry, but I don’t think I can make it tonight.

turns.prompt: 你想了解朋友临时取消安排的原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh, is everything okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, is everything okay?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Sure. Did something come up?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Did something come up?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: That’s okay. Can I ask what happened?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. Can I ask what happened?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: No problem. Is it work, or something else?

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Is it work, or something else?
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: Why you suddenly canceled our date?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, is everything okay?
feedback.explanation: 过去发生的事直接问原因需用“Why did you …?”，有“did”后“cancel”用原形。

turns.text: Work. My manager asked me to stay late.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: Ah, okay. That makes sense.

feedback.naturalExpression: Ah, okay. That makes sense.
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: Got it. Do you know how late you’ll be working?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Do you know how late you’ll be working?
feedback.explanation: “how late”问最晚到几点，常用于确认营业或可使用的时间。

choices.text: That’s rough. Do you want to reschedule?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s rough. Do you want to reschedule?
feedback.explanation: 用于邀请或商量，先确认对方是否愿意，再决定后续安排。

choices.text: Okay. I was just worried something had happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I was just worried something had happened.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Saturday works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Saturday works for me.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Sure. Same time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Same time?
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yeah, let’s do Saturday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, let’s do Saturday.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: C｜已经发生很多次
scenarios.setting: 这是对方一个月内第三次临时取消约会。

turns.text: I’m really sorry, but can we reschedule tonight?

turns.prompt: 你想指出临时取消已经多次发生，会怎么说？

choices.text: This is the third time you’ve canceled at the last minute.

feedback.naturalExpression: This is the third time you’ve canceled at the last minute.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: Honestly, I’m starting to feel like this isn’t a priority for you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I’m starting to feel like this isn’t a priority for you.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I understand things come up, but this keeps happening.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand things come up, but this keeps happening.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I’m getting a little tired of making plans that keep getting canceled.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m getting a little tired of making plans that keep getting canceled.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

turns.text: That’s not fair. I’ve genuinely been busy.

turns.prompt: 你想解释反复取消对你的影响，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m not saying you’re doing it on purpose, but it still affects me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not saying you’re doing it on purpose, but it still affects me.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I understand you’re busy. I’m just telling you how this feels from my side.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand you’re busy. I’m just telling you how this feels from my side.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Maybe you’re too busy to date right now, and that’s okay—but I’d rather know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe you’re too busy to date right now, and that’s okay—but I’d rather know.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: I don’t need you to be available all the time. I just need plans to mean something when we make them.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t need you to be available all the time. I just need plans to mean something when we make them.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t need”说明当前不需要这项服务或物品，避免对方继续安排。

turns.text: I do want to see you. Things have just been crazy lately.

turns.prompt: 关于「对方突然取消约会」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Then maybe you should reach out when you actually have time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Then maybe you should reach out when you actually have time.
feedback.explanation: “reach out”表示主动联系或寻求支持，常用于邀请对方以后再来沟通。

choices.text: Okay. Let’s stop scheduling things for now and see when you’re genuinely free.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Let’s stop scheduling things for now and see when you’re genuinely free.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: I like seeing you, but I don’t want to keep doing this.

feedback.naturalExpression: I like seeing you, but I don’t want to keep doing this.
feedback.explanation: “I like”直接分享喜好，后面说出具体类别，能给对方继续聊的话题。

choices.text: I think we need to be realistic about whether this is working.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we need to be realistic about whether this is working.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。
